name: evoting-osis-sman21
description: E-Voting Pemilihan Ketua OSIS SMAN 21 Kota Surabaya

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db
scripts.setup: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
